readers.q1: Pressing "Give the order" sends march-to-Lorraine orders to the ticked corps, Ney and Davout. Each is a 2-action order. The box is titled "Orders for 4 corps", but only two are ticked and will actually go.
readers.q2: It costs 4 actions (2 + 2), out of the 4 you have. You can afford it, but it uses all of your actions.
readers.q3: Soult will not go, because he already stands at Lorraine. Lannes also will not go as things stand. He is unticked because there are not enough actions left for him.
readers.q4: Untick his box. You can click his row, or use Up/Down to reach it and press Space. (Davout is currently ticked.)
readers.q5: Use "Take back" or press Ctrl+Z. It undoes all the ticked orders together, so Ney's and Davout's marches are both cancelled. It also gives their actions back. The text does not say whether this is still possible after the turn ends.
readers.q6: The Army of Italy panel (Lannes and Murat) has a "Hold..." button. The log also says you can say "Army of Italy, hold". Press the button, then click a province to send them there. The panel says Hold..., Fortify... and Drill... show each corps' order and price first, and nothing is spent until you press Give.

readers.q8: Lannes is not ticked because only 4 actions are in hand, and Ney and Davout use all 4 (2 + 2). To send him, untick another corps (Ney or Davout) and then tick Lannes.
readers.q9: Pressing "Hold..." does not give the order straight away. The panel says it shows each corps' order and its price first, and that nothing is spent until you press Give. The screenshots do not show what that preview looks like.
